declaration.reason: Owner-authorised 24 November 2026 meeting governance change for meeting-specific Chairperson, Secretary and Meeting Administrator appointments; temporary Transition Committee election workflow; server-enforced role separation; meeting-scoped invitations, ballots and media moderation; and immediate Transition Committee mandate expiry when formal proceedings begin. This change explicitly includes the necessary meeting-scoped Firestore authorization rules; no unrelated collection, portal or signature rules are changed.
declaration.expectedEffect: Allow every IRPA member and employee identity to access the complete Meeting Portal across all meeting categories and initiate/register meetings without an active-status, role, department, invitation or participant-list gate; permit initial registration with no permanent leadership appointments; require a complete temporary Transition Committee before leadership-election invitations and ballots; allow eligible participants to vote only in that election; require all three permanent meeting appointments and closed election ballots before proceedings; expire temporary authority atomically at proceedings start; keep Meeting Administrator authority operational only; preserve Board-only quorum, voting, resolutions, signature and record protections. The legacy Firebase LiveKit callable is also hardened so only the meeting-specific Meeting Administrator can receive room moderation or control recording; global administrators, initiators, Chairpersons and Secretaries cannot obtain technical moderation by legacy callable paths. The Voting Process page now opens and closes ballots through the meeting Worker using the current meeting's Chairperson/Secretary or active Transition Committee Chairperson/Secretary; global administrator status alone does not confer voting control. Ordinary governance votes remain Board-member-only, while pre-proceedings leadership-election ballots admit listed active members and employees.
prohibitedChanges: Do not create portal-wide meeting leadership roles.
Do not allow Meeting Administrator to chair, vote, establish quorum, approve resolutions or approve minutes by virtue of that role.
Do not retain Transition Committee authority after formal proceedings begin.
Do not allow appointments or permissions to leak between concurrent meetings.
Do not weaken Board quorum, ordinary governance voting, signature, legal-hold, retention, audit or protected deletion safeguards.
Do not change unrelated Firestore collections or other portal permissions.

validation: Universal access implemented in App navigation (including access without organisational-role selection), shared client policy, Meeting Centre queries, Worker and legacy callable read paths, production and staging Firestore meeting rules, attendance register reads and working-document review. Verified external invitees retain access only to their invited meeting and live-room entry remains invitation/appointment controlled. The Meeting Administrator alone controls participant admission/removal, attendance marking and technical media moderation; Chairperson/Secretary retain proceedings and secretariat authority. All three meeting-specific appointments are required before proceedings; Transition Committee authority ends at proceedings start. Board-restricted records remain protected. Worker and legacy record paths enforce minimum ten-year retention and reconcile existing records when the register is retrieved. Real meetings and linked governance records cannot be directly deleted; only TRIAL meetings/children may be deleted. CI and production verification pending.
